spiral_turns.name: RETURN_TO_SEED_AFTER_SPIRAL
spiral_turns.answer_after_spiral: JSON is still not proof and not computation authority. Its strongest JANUS role is a typed, canonicalizable, provenance-carrying intermediate contract that can name exact semantics, representation language, allowed operation capabilities, paid costs, deferred obligations and replay receipts.
spiral_turns.current_form: proof-state contract with certified cost semantics

external_spider_bridges.prior_art_family: Myhill-Nerode style quotienting by indistinguishable continuations and bisimulation-style quotient/congruence in transition systems
external_spider_bridges.relation: Strong structural analogy for MK_FUTURE. It narrows novelty: quotienting by future behavior is not novel by itself; JANUS must define its authorized continuation language and exact proof-state semantics explicitly.
Directly supports evaluating representation languages jointly by succinctness and polynomial-time queries/transformations; aligns strongly with Gamma_L and representation portfolio accounting.

External theorem boundary showing that compact representation can lose polynomial-time closure under NOT, OR and existential quantification; supports R3B capability contracts but is never an internal receipt.

Gamma_L behaves analogically like an effect/capability contract: it describes which operations are certified available, unavailable, unknown or debt-producing. This suggests a typed execution judgment for R3C.
R2D/R3C receipts should separate producer from verifier and validate semantic preservation of each executable representation transition rather than trusting the translating backend.

The conserved debt ledger suggests an explicit potential/debt function for lifecycle accounting so deferred work, verification liabilities and switching liabilities cannot disappear between snapshots.

MK_FUTURE can be studied as a precise abstraction/concretization contract: sound quotienting requires a formal relation between exact proof states and abstract future interfaces. This may help separate soundness, completeness and precision from representation cost.

spiral_level_findings.strongest_positive: The architecture repeatedly preserved exact semantic authority while allowing bounded safe future-state merges, exact cross-language transitions and explicit lifecycle capability planning.
spiral_level_findings.strongest_negative: Every apparent shortcut can move hidden complexity into a different axis: representation size, representation discovery, certification, cumulative switching or deferred future work.

engineering_meta_law_candidate.name: NO_FREE_SEMANTIC_COMPRESSION
engineering_meta_law_candidate.statement: A smaller exact or candidate interface does not establish computational savings until representation, discovery, translation, verification, update, cumulative switching and deferred-work liabilities are all explicitly bounded and paid.

spiral_level_findings.novelty_assessment: Most ingredients have strong external antecedents. The potentially distinctive object is their JANUS composition into an append-only, proof-state future quotient plus representation-capability lifecycle contract with paid discovery/certification/debt and exact replay. External novelty of that composition remains UNESTABLISHED.
